question.problem:
Let ${X}_{1},{X}_{2},…,{X}_{80}$ be a random sample of size $n=80$ from a population with a population mean $\mu =150$ and population standard deviation $\sigma =40.$ Find an approximation for the probability that the sample mean is between $140$ and $148.$ *Hint: Two tables of values of $Φ(z)$ for different values of $z$ are given below, where $Φ(z)$ is the cumulative distribution function for the standard normal distribution. *
$z$$\,0.03\,$$\,0.04\,$$\,0.05\,$
$\,-2.3\,$ $\,0.0099\,$ $\,0.0096\,$ $\,0.0094\,$
$\,-2.2\,$ $\,0.0129\,$ $\,0.0125\,$ $\,0.0122\,$
$\,-2.1\,$ $\,0.0166\,$ $\,0.0162\,$ $\,0.0158\,$

$z$$\,0.04\,$$\,0.05\,$$\,0.06\,$
$\,-0.4\,$ $\,0.3300\,$ $\,0.3264\,$ $\,0.3228\,$
$\,-0.3\,$ $\,0.3669\,$ $\,0.3632\,$ $\,0.3594\,$
$\,-0.2\,$ $\,0.4052\,$ $\,0.4013\,$ $\,0.3974\,$
question.worked_solution:
Suppose that ${X}_{1},{X}_{2},…,{X}_{n}$ is a random sample of size $n$ from a population with a population mean $\mu $ and population standard deviation $\sigma .$ The central limit theorem (or CLT) states that for sufficiently large $n,$ the distribution of the sample mean $\overset{―}{X}$ can be approximated as 

$$
\overset{―}{X}∼N\,(\mu ,\frac{{\sigma }^{2}}{n}).
$$

In our case, we have

$$
n=80,\,\mu =150,\,\sigma =40.
$$

Therefore, by the CLT, we have that the distribution of the sample mean can be approximated as

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{X} & ∼N\,(\mu ,\frac{{\sigma }^{2}}{n}) \\  & ∼N\,(150,\frac{{40}^{2}}{80}) \\  & ∼N(150,20).\end{aligned}
$$

We want to find $P(140<\overset{―}{X}<148).$ So, we convert $\overset{―}{X}$ to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(140<\overset{―}{X}<148) & =P(\frac{140-150}{\sqrt{20}}<Z<\frac{148-150}{\sqrt{20}}) \\  & =P(-\sqrt{5}<Z<-\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}) \\  & ≈P(-2.24<Z<-0.45) \\  & =P(Z<-0.45)-P(Z<-2.24) \\  & =Φ(-0.45)-Φ(-2.24)\end{aligned}
$$

From the tables, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}Φ(-2.24)=0.0125, \\ Φ(-0.45)=0.3264.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(140<\overset{―}{X}<148) & =Φ(-0.45)-Φ(-2.24) \\  & =0.3264-0.0125 \\  & =0.3139.\end{aligned}
$$
